posts.author: sparta212
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
Long time ago I saw an image of a Cave with a big skull entrance, I guess it was for MV or MZ. It was a 3x4 and each raw had a different cave design, like first was normal, second had cracks, third had vines...
I don't know if the maker of that image is on this forum, or if anyone saw or has the file. I would like to have it for my project, and I've been searching for it for days using many keywords and looking on many art websites.
The image kinda look like the attachement (but obviously in RPG Maker style). I appreciate all the help I can get.
Note : All rights belong to the maker of the image I am looking for.
